review_notes: I read the whole file, lines 1–120. It introduces no definitions, structures, classes or instances. It contains only theorems and two private helper lemmas: smul_omega_sub_eq and mulVec_toMatrix_comp_eq. These are about existing Mathlib notions: AlgHom, LinearMap.toMatrix, IsRegular, IsUnit, Matrix.det, and the trace, norm and star on QuadraticAlgebra. The trace, norm and star notions come from Basic.lean, not from this file. The rubric excludes standalone theorem duplication and proof shortening, so I found no competing concept in this file to compare against Mathlib. I did not search Mathlib for theorem-level overlaps, and I did not check how Basic.lean defines trace and norm against Algebra.trace and Algebra.norm. That check would belong to a review of Basic.lean, not this file.
